# `jouet pr threads apply`

- **Usage:** `jouet pr threads apply [FLAGS] [ARGS]…`

Reply to and resolve many threads from a JSON list

The list holds {"id": N, "reply": "...", "resolve": true} entries. Every entry is checked before anything is posted. Re-running the same list after a failure is safe: resolved threads and replies already posted are skipped.

## Arguments
- **`[ARGS]…`** — `-` to read the list from stdin, and optionally the PR

## Flags
- **`--file <FILE>`** — Read the list from FILE (`-` is stdin)
- **`--ignore-resolved`** — Skip threads that are already resolved instead of failing
- **`--dry-run`** — Check everything and show what would be posted, posting nothing
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
